reasoning: Both models correctly identified the PKGBUILD as safe with legitimate Mozilla sources and integrity checks. The language pack files (.xpi and extracted localization data) pose no execution risk during build/install as they're inert resources. No malicious patterns were found.
coverage_issues: qwen model skipped all source files (only reviewed PKGBUILD), missing opportunity to validate file integrity patterns
learnings: Improve file prioritization: Models should focus on build/install hooks over localization data. PKGBUILD and .install files are critical; translation files are low-risk.
Enhance binary handling: Develop methods to validate signed binaries (e.g., Mozilla .xpi) when checksums exist.
Refine file selection prompts: Prevent empty responses (like deepseek's initial attempt) by clarifying expectations for prebuilt packages.
Optimize cost: Avoid reviewing numerous localization files (as deepseek did) since they don't execute during packaging.
